newsitem.title: USA: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Nov final 99.2.
newsitem.headline: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Nov final 99.2.

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for November rose to 99.2 compared with 96.5 in the final October index, financial market sources said on Wednesday.
The current conditions component rose to 107.5 in the November final report against the 106.6 reading in the final October.
The expectations index rose to 93.9 in the final November data versus the 89.9 in the final October, the sources added. The data are released only to paying subscribers.
